channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ben Simmons | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ben Simmons from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Scott Perry on Ben Simmons
item.description:
After a conversation with Suhr, Kings general manager Scott Perry paid a visit to Miami to watch Simmons work out in late August.

“Around the time he was participating with the Australian national team, I got a couple calls from people in Australia mentioning the fact that Ben Simmons is here and he’s playing really, really well, he looks healthy again and a little bit reminiscent of his days in Philadelphia,”

Scott Perry on Ben Simmons, Oct 12, 2026. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Marcus Morris on Ben Simmons
item.description:
Marcus Morris on Ben Simmons:

“If he would have stayed in Philadelphia, he’d still be a star now, and by now, I feel like they’d have got a chip.”

Marcus Morris on Ben Simmons, Jan 8, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Ben Simmons, Trendon Watford
item.description:
Fullcourtpass: Joel Embiid on Trendon Watford's performance:

“Reminded me of Ben Simmons tonight. We miss those. Triple double, doing everything. That was good.”

Joel Embiid on Ben Simmons, Trendon Watford, Nov 9, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on James Harden, Ben Simmons
item.description:
Kyrie on the Nets trading Harden for Simmons:

“It shocked a lot of people. It shocked me. Shit I was talking to James one day and I'm like shit bro we about to go win these championships and it was like a day later, asked for a trade. I understood completely”

Kyrie Irving on James Harden, Ben Simmons, Jul 23, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Ben Simmons
item.description:
Tyronn Lue on usage of Ben Simmons:

“He can push the pace when he rebounds the basketball. Unbelievable passer. Can put him at the elbows. Use him in transition. When he's playing with 1st unit when Zu is out/playing the 5 ⚠️more so the corner, catch uphill, DHOs, play off that”

Tyronn Lue on Ben Simmons, Feb 11, 2025. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Ben Simmons
item.description:
Tyronn Lue on Ben Simmons:

“It's going to take some time, because you have a point guard who can play the center and the point, depending on what unit he's on…with that second unit, I thought him and Bogie had a good thing going out there on the floor.”

Tyronn Lue on Ben Simmons, Feb 11, 2025. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on D'Angelo Russell, Ben Simmons
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez:

“D'Angelo [Russell] had a shin contusion, so we'll keep him out for today, and then we'll see how he feels. With Ben [Simmons], it's just management with his calf... Want him to feel better and [we'll] see how many days it takes. We're not going to rush him.”

Jordi Fernandez on D'Angelo Russell, Ben Simmons, Jan 6, 2025. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Ben Simmons, Nic Claxton
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on whether he still views Ben Simmons and Nic Claxton as a viable pairing in a featured lineup:

“With the limitations as far as health and minutes, we haven’t been able to, but we could for sure see it. Right now, the team has been competing well. The groups that have been put together have worked, but I’m not saying that this is the only thing we will do. I’m open to trying different groups.”

Jordi Fernandez on Ben Simmons, Nic Claxton, Nov 7, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Ben Simmons
item.description:
Erik Slater:Jordi Fernandez on Ben Simmons attempting four shots in 25 minutes today:

“I want him to shoot more. My goal for him is 10 [shots per game].He's gotta find a way to get there. He hasn't gotten there, but I know he can... Those attempts need to go up... He's more than capable.”

Jordi Fernandez on Ben Simmons, Nov 3, 2024. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Ben Simmons, Dennis Schroder
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on the Nets’ starting point guard battle between Dennis Schroder and Ben Simmons:

“I want to be put in a tough spot. These are two really good players. They both want to start, and that's what I want. I want to create healthy competition within the group, and then from there, make me decide... If they don't meet expectations, they won't be the starting point guard.”

Jordi Fernandez on Ben Simmons, Dennis Schroder, Oct 1, 2024. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Dennis Schroeder on Ben Simmons
item.description:
Dennis Schroeder on Ben Simmons:

“Minicamp, we had a whole week where we played together & looked great. So Im really excited about him being healthy. All the noise on social media, what everybody was saying about him, Im really looking forward for him to shut everybody up.”

Dennis Schroeder on Ben Simmons, Sep 30, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Cameron Johnson on Ben Simmons
item.description:
Brooklyn Nets forwardCam Johnson:

“We get a healthy Ben (Simmons) back, and with the stuff we were able to do with him in the lineup last year, I think there’s a lot of potential.”

Cameron Johnson on Ben Simmons, Jul 14, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Kevin Ollie on Ben Simmons
item.description:
Kevin Ollie on Ben Simmons:

“I know he has a lot of motions that's inside of him. But he's been down this road before and I know he's gonna get prepared with his team, our medical staff, our organization, and we have empathy for him.”

Kevin Ollie on Ben Simmons, Mar 7, 2024. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Kevin Ollie on Ben Simmons
item.description:
Kevin Ollie on Ben Simmons' injury status being changed to a left lower back nerve impingement:

“We were just trying to get to the source of it and that's why the change of the wording was, but he's still day-to-day, still on the court, and hopefully we can get him back soon.”

Kevin Ollie on Ben Simmons, Mar 4, 2024. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Ben Simmons
item.description:
Jacque Vaughn:

“(Simmons) just impacts other people. He makes other dudes better. And he likes doing that. And when you get a guy that wants to do that on a nightly basis, it's infectious. The ball movement tonight, he was the reason for that.”

Jacque Vaughn on Ben Simmons, Jan 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Nicolas Claxton on Ben Simmons
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Nic Claxton on Ben Simmons’ probable return tonight vs the #Jazz:

“He definitely helps us. It's good to see him back with a group. Of course, he brings just an extremely high basketball IQ, being able to defend multiple positions on the defensive side of the ball, rebound.”

Nicolas Claxton on Ben Simmons, Jan 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Ben Simmons, Mikal Bridges
item.description:
Joel Embiid on Ben Simmons:

“I’ve always been one of those people that didn’t believe [Simmons] actually needed a jumper, like he was so good, he’s just a monster….Almost as fast as you (Maxey).... I just believed that you know if he could find a way to get his free throws to 75-80% that woulda changedeverything.... You can talk about this could have happened, the mistakes that have been made during the draft of Mikal Bridges but that’s just one [of the many franchise mistakes]… but I think that’s the perfect match… I think that’s the one that got away. I just hate the fact that the way things happened….”

Joel Embiid on Ben Simmons, Mikal Bridges, Dec 10, 2023. Source: LibertyBallers.com.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Ben Simmons
item.description:
Jacque Vaughn on Ben Simmons:

“He received treatment, and he'll continue to receive treatment. Just not in the place where all parties around feel comfortable with him playing at the levels that he's been playing it.”

Jacque Vaughn on Ben Simmons, Nov 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Ben Simmons
item.description:
#Sixers coach Nick Nurse on Ben Simmons:

“First couple games. looks very good. He looks in shape, he looks confident and pretty aggressive. And it looks like they've got a package of stuff in for him, right? So it looks like he's ready to go.”

Nick Nurse on Ben Simmons, Oct 16, 2023. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Ben Simmons, Nic Claxton
item.description:
Jacque Vaughn on his approach with Ben Simmons and Nic Claxton sharing the floor:

“I gotta have the right combination around them. Those other three guys have to be the right three guys. The spacing around them has to be pretty premium and pretty detailed. And then we’ve gotta put Ben and Nic in positions to react with the basketball, without the basketball with what their spacing looks like.”

Jacque Vaughn on Ben Simmons, Nic Claxton, Oct 4, 2023. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Cam Thomas on Ben Simmons
item.description:
Cam Thomas on what looks different about Ben Simmons heading into this year:

“Honestly, he just looks more explosive than last year... When he's in transition now, he's full go. Last year he was a little tentative... I've really seen that from him in the offseason so far.”

Cam Thomas on Ben Simmons, Oct 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Sean Marks on Bernie Lee, Ben Simmons
item.description:
Sean Marks on Ben Simmons not playing the World Cup:

“I just think that he ran out of time. I mean, getting in game shape and getting ready to play then, it's just not worth the risk. So, you know, he and I talked, and with Bernie Lee, his agent, we talked about it and said, look, this wasn't the right time for him. I know he wants to play for them in the future so that's gonna be exciting when he gets out there and represents his country.”

Sean Marks on Bernie Lee, Ben Simmons, Jul 11, 2023. Source: Sirius XM.

item.title: Sean Marks on Ben Simmons
item.description:
Sean Marks on Ben Simmons:

“The updates that we have so far, I checked in with him two weeks ago. I was down there watching him in Miami working out, and so he's back on the court. He looks like he's in good shape. He's not in game shape yet. That's to be expected. But he's moving without pain, he's in a great mind frame, and peace of mind. So, look, as it's going right now we're very bullish on him returning and returning to great form. And I think that's how Ben's approaching this thing too, which is great.”

Sean Marks on Ben Simmons, Jul 11, 2023. Source: Sirius XM.

item.title: Sean Marks on Ben Simmons
item.description:
Erik Slater:Sean Marks on expectations for Ben Simmons next season:

“I think the hope is that he returns to that (All-Star) level of play. I mean, if he was 35 years old, I wouldn't honestly be able to tell you that. But I think knowing that he's mid-20s and he has still hopefully not reached his prime, we’ve gotta make sure he can get back out there and get back to that form. And hopefully we see we see his game even evolve past that. But health is going to be the key to him.”

Sean Marks on Ben Simmons, Jul 9, 2023. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Sean Marks on Ben Simmons
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Marks on Ben Simmons not playing in the #FIBA World Cup:

“This particular summer he just ran out of time. It just wasn't the right thing to doto put him out there without playing and rushing it.... This was made in Brooklyn’s best interest and Ben’s longterm health.”

Sean Marks on Ben Simmons, Jul 9, 2023. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Ben Simmons
item.description:
But though he has pulled out of that tournament, he’s back on the court working out, in constant contact with the Nets and progressing toward a healthy start to training camp at the beginning of October.

“We’ve had contact for sure. All of our guys have been locked-in, really keeping us informed. … I’m looking forward to a healthy Ben Simmons and coaching him,”

Jacque Vaughn on Ben Simmons, Jul 8, 2023. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Sean Marks on Ben Simmons
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Sean Marks on Ben Simmons:

“He is checking the boxes & meeting these different markers along the way. So at this point, he does not need surgery. That is the hope going forward, that he will not have to endure another surgery.”

Sean Marks on Ben Simmons, Apr 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Michael Porter on Ben Simmons
item.description:
He averaged just 9.3 points the following season, but erupted for 19.0 points per game the next.

“People are so hard on Ben Simmons. But I know what he’s going through as far as he’s able to play right now, but he’s not back to Ben Simmons, and it’ll take awhile for him to have all the explosiveness,”

Michael Porter on Ben Simmons, Apr 2, 2023. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Ben Simmons
item.description:
Jacque Vaughn on Ben Simmons:

“During his strengthening process he did experience some back soreness. So now we're in the process of strengthening the knee while also managing the back.”

Jacque Vaughn on Ben Simmons, Mar 3, 2023. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Ben Simmons
item.description:
Jacque Vaughn on Ben Simmons' workload before his calf injury:

“Maybe that was a sign to us that those minutes were too many... We’ll be very smart in if he’s going to play back-to-backs and what those minutes look like, probably not high 30s like they were on some occasions.”

Jacque Vaughn on Ben Simmons, Dec 14, 2022. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.
